notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’ve added a new level selection screen based on your requests. Now you can easily go back and replay levels you’ve completed. We also added a quick button to switch between single-player and two-player modes. This means you can play one level alone and bring a friend for the next one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44342928/a1f64741bdf494e14f40ab519dbe2580745fa49d.png[/img]

We’ve made some changes to the secret ducks and limited the number of hints you can use. We also reduced extra text in the game—many menu options are now shown as icons.

Thanks for your support! We’re still working on more updates. Enjoy the game!
